name: KeyCut
tagline: Final Cut Pro shortcuts on your iPad, fired straight to your Mac.
description: A colour-coded control surface for video editors. Tap a key on the iPad and it sends the real Final Cut Pro shortcut to your Mac over Wi-Fi, via the free KeyCut Live helper. Free to download, one-off unlock for the full set.
platforms: iPad and iPhone, with a Mac helper
os: iOS 17 or later, macOS 14 or later

name: Who Is My MP?
tagline: Your postcode, your MP, and the whole public record.
description: Enter a postcode and see who represents you in the Commons, then how they voted, what they said, what they asked and what they declared. Every item links back to Parliament's own record. No account, no analytics, your postcode stays on your phone.
priceNote: Free, optional upgrade for full speech text and search

name: The Lords
tagline: Find peers by what they know, not where they sit.
description: The House of Lords has no constituencies, so any peer can take up your issue. The Lords lets you find members of the upper house by the subjects they specialise in, and read their record in the same plain way.

name: VENDUM Coffee
tagline: Reorder your beans with Apple Pay in two taps.
description: The app for VENDUM Coffee, a small-batch roastery in Plumstead. Order beans, manage a subscription, and use the App Clip on the back of every bag to reorder the moment it runs out. No account, no password.

name: Bikes&.co GPS theft tracker
tagline: Know where your bike is, even when you don't.
description: Companion app for the Bikes&.co GPS tracker. Hide the tracker on the bike, see where it is on the map, and get told if it moves when it shouldn't.

name: Bikes&.co cycling gear
tagline: Socks, a flask and a musette. That's the range.
description: The shop app for Bikes&.co cycling gear, ordered in a couple of taps.
